sourceText: 停在TEST怎么解决？那就并行TEST是不是可以解决门禁上限问题？能不能解决？别问我。
normalizedOutcome: Official Proofbound validation commands in the same git workspace no longer run concurrently and cause unchanged 120/180/300-second proof gates to fail from resource contention; a second command visibly waits and then runs automatically.
acceptanceClaim: With one official validation holding workspace capacity, a different-story or no-story validate/done_required_validate reports the holder without entering its callback, then automatically runs after release and produces its own normal PASS evidence while command inventories and timeout budgets remain unchanged.
